flashcard_questions.q: What share of American workers were unemployed by 1933?
By how much were the wages of those still in work cut between 1929 and 1933?
How many families had their homes repossessed in 1932 alone?
By how much did suicide rates rise between 1929 and 1932?
What name was given to the shanty towns built by homeless Americans?
Which phrase did Hoover famously repeat as the Depression deepened?
What was Hoover's belief that Americans should help themselves, not rely on government, called?
Which body did Hoover set up in 1932 to lend money to banks and businesses?
Which 1930 tariff worsened the Depression by cutting international trade?
How many First World War veterans marched on Washington in the summer of 1932?
Which general led the troops who cleared the Bonus Army camp?
What name was given to the dust storm of 14 April 1935 that turned day into night?
How many acres did the Dust Bowl affect at its peak?
What nickname was given to Dust Bowl migrants who headed to California?
How many states did Roosevelt carry in the 1932 election?

notes: 15 cards: 8 statistic, 4 term or nickname, 2 person or body, 1 quotation. Dropped the Toledo and Cleveland unemployment pair to avoid interference, and kept the national one-in-four figure instead.
